text:
Alex: Heads up — one of the p4d nodes in us-west-2 started throwing repeated Xid 13 spikes yesterday, ECC corrected errors climbing. GPU serial: GPU-SN-9A3F7C. Node: infer-uw2-12. Observed flaky hangs ~3x in last 24h. Do we RMA or try reseat? Need vendor ticket + swap plan. :thinking:

Jamie: @Alex thx. First step: drain node and preserve logs. If not already, run the usual captures and open a vendor ticket.

Jamie: ```
kubectl cordon infer-uw2-12
kubectl drain infer-uw2-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
sudo dmesg -T | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg-gpu-uw2-12.log
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,serial,ecc.errors --format=csv -f /tmp/gpu-ecc.csv
```

Jamie: When you open the vendor ticket (PNY/Dell), attach logs + csv + short repro steps. Tag as `RMA: high-ecc`. Ask for depot-swap and request courier hold if they require photos — saves back-and-forth. :clipboard:

Maria: Spare pool check: we have 2 P4d spares in us-west spare-rack-3. We can hot-swap to avoid downtime, but procurement flagged that last-month returns hit an "insurance hold" when photos/invoice missing.

Cheng: Vendor replied on ticket VN-8832 — they need 3 photos (front, connector, sticker) + signed RMA form. Also flagged transit insurance hold: they require a commercial invoice/declared value for depot swaps; hold could add ~3-5 biz days.

Alex: I can take photos and attach right now. Question: do we pull from spare or wait for depot swap? Using spare reduces downtime but complicates warranty chain/serial tracking.

Jamie: Use spare for immediate mitigation. Quick checklist: 1) tag spare serial in ticket metadata (spare_serial: SPARE-7C22) 2) update inventory sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDACTED) 3) schedule 15m change window for hot-swap 4) add incident note with downtime est. :white_check_mark:

rma-bot: RMA created — VN-8832. Attachments required: photos, dmesg, gpu-ecc.csv. Please upload to ticket. (automated)

Maria: I'll coordinate the physical swap. @Alex pls upload photos to the ticket and ping once the node is cordoned. I'll provision the spare and run perf smoke after install. :truck:

Alex: Uploaded photos + logs to ticket (attached dmesg and gpu-ecc.csv). Node cordoned and drained. Ready for swap. :camera_flash:

Jamie: Scheduling swap at 17:30 PST. Spare serial SPARE-7C22 -> will replace GPU-SN-9A3F7C. After swap: run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv` and run 2x inference smoke tests (~5 min).

Cheng: I'll update vendor: request prepaid return label and ask for insured transit option given previous holds. Also adding a 'serial escrow' note to the ticket for audit trail — store failed serial + spare mapping.

Alex: Swap completed, node back in (uncordon + kubectl uncordon infer-uw2-12). Perf looks normal on smoke runs. Marked failed GPU as "awaiting pickup" in ticket and uploaded final photos. Thanks team :thumbsup:

rma-bot: Ticket VN-8832 updated: status=awaiting pickup, return_label=pending, expected_pickup=3 business days. Attachments verified: photos, dmesg, gpu-ecc.csv.

Jamie: Quick note for ops org: using spare avoids ~12-18h downtime cost but we should log the replacement in CAPEX tracker (spare depreciation) vs vendor swap cost. I'll file a short cost note in the ticket.

Maria: Added inventory mapping entry and Slack link to ticket for audit. Closing loop: once vendor confirms pickup, we'll change status to 'in transit' and then 'RMA closed' on receipt.

Alex: Closing thread — keep VN-8832 pinned until pickup. If vendor refuses insured return, escalate to procurement.
